entities.summary: Shihab, a notable figure in the history of Lebanon, associated with Emirate of Mount Lebanon (1697–1842). Preceded by Ottomans capture and execute Fakhreddine II in Istanbul and Fakhreddine II and the Ma'n Emirate. Their legacy influenced Bashir II allies with Egypt's Ibrahim Pasha against the Ottomans and Druze-Maronite sectarian conflict leads to the end of the emirate system.
